note: Every LM_ material is a shared PBR library set (client/src/village/pbr/pbrLibrary.ts getPbrSet(id, tier, gl) -> createPbrMaterial(set, { repeatMeters: [1, 1] })): the model's UVs are metres, COLOR_0 multiplies the albedo (the tint of the neutral sets), roughness = the ORM's G times roughnessScale. The lot has no maps of its own (letters, clock and numerals are geometry). M_glass is the game's glass; lotnight__ nodes take the game's glow.

M_screen.note: the garden-and-sky view behind interior windows: unlit, COLOR_0 is the colour
